units: world units; seconds; milliseconds for inference

protocols.algorithm: Zero equal computation latency. Same delayed cutoff, 2.4s warmup, robot and fixed 300ms horizon.
protocols.deployment: Measured per-call CPU latency, one inference lane; busy requests skipped and counted. Result applied on first 60Hz control tick after completion. Missed deadlines hold, never substitute another predictor.

interceptionRule: Count entry into capture radius; rearm only after separation > captureRadius + 0.04. Continue after catches.
